title: They were told to expect an attack… then they heard Silent Night 🕯️
caption:
They were told to expect an attack… then they heard Silent Night 🕯️ Christmas Eve 1914, the night the Christmas truce began. A true story.

Would you have been the first to stand up? Tell us in the comments 👇

Sometimes peace starts with one voice in the dark.

"The First to Stand Up" – the whole true story as a book.

slides.text: They expected an attack. Then the enemy sang.
Christmas Eve 1914. Headquarters warned: the Germans might attack tonight.
Then lights appeared along the German trenches. Candles on little Christmas trees.
And over there, they began to sing: "Silent Night".
The British listened. Then they sang back. Song after song.
Next morning, someone had to be the first to stand up.
Would you have stood up first?

firstComment: Most people say they'd have stayed in the trench. Would you? 👀
